title: Implement session context struct carrying all per-connection state
description:
Define SessionContext: current state (SessionState), authenticated user (Option<String>), tls_active (bool), current_group (Option<GroupName>), current_article_number (Option<u64>), peer_addr (SocketAddr). Session context is passed to every command handler. Artifact: reader/src/session/context.rs.

Acceptance: all state fields present; context is cheaply cloneable or passed by mutable reference; unit test: confirm initial state is Authenticating when auth_required=true, Active otherwise
